title: Chapter 1453 - 4: The Tremor Of Endless Dimensional Yuan

Chapter 1453 - 4: The Tremor Of Endless Dimensional Yuan

Chapter 1453 - 4: The Tremor of Endless Dimensional Yuan

"For an ordinary Time Lord of the first stage, sealing this rift might require a significant sacrifice, perhaps even calling upon friends. No wonder it's considered the final calamity of the first phase."

Lin Yuan smiled slightly: "Yet for me, it's still quite simple.

After observing the rift for a brief moment, Lin Yuan had understood enough to proceed with the sealing.

Whoosh!

The very next moment.

Lin Yuan appeared near the terrifying rift.

The frightening pull from the rift couldn't shake Lin Yuan in the slightest.

With Lin Yuan's arrival.

From the depths of the terrifying rift, waves of will suddenly emanated.

"If you don't want to die, scram." These waves of will were laced with a cold, ruthless tone: "Before you, many like you have tried to seal me, yet I've devoured them all."

"Oh?"

Lin Yuan was slightly moved.

The existence of a will in the depths of the terrifying rift wasn't unexpected.

But according to the other party, there had been Lords here before attempting a sealing, only to fail?

"It seems the first stage of the 'Endless Calamity' isn't guaranteed to be overcome." Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The first phase consists of 3.6 billion and two thousand calamities, usually manageable with caution, but mishaps occur, and some Lords don't succeed.

Lords who failed to seal the terrifying rift naturally met a singular fate. That is, they were erased by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

"What about you? Do you wish to be devoured by me as well?" The will from the depths of the rift asked with growing interest upon seeing Lin Yuan remain.

These words were meant to lure Lin Yuan closer, for the devouring of such powerful lifeforms could nourish it.

"I believe you won't be able to devour me."

Lin Yuan stepped forward again, approaching the very edge of the terrifying rift.

"Hahahaha, fool."

The will from the depths of the rift burst into laughter, and the nearby suction surged dramatically, even space-time itself rushed toward the

rift.

"Taiyi." With a fleeting thought, Lin Yuan summoned a wisp of Taiyi Power, transforming it into chains that began to cover the terrifying rift.

To ensure a swift resolution without prolonging the ordeal, Lin Yuan intended to seal the rift at full speed without holding back.

Buzzz~ The seemingly inconspicuous Taiyi Power, as it stretched over the terrifying rift, grew larger and thicker, obscuring the sky and rapidly ensnaring the rift.

"What a terrifying method, you must be the strongest among those who seek to seal me." The will from the depth conveyed its sentiment again: "Yet, merely with these, you cannot seal me."

"Tai Chu." With another subtle thought, Lin Yuan gathered Tai Chu

power, continuing to weave them into chains to cover the terrifying rift.

Taiyi and Taichu, as the forefront of the "Innate Five Great," rapidly formed two fundamentally different chains, instantly encompassing and enveloping the entire terrifying rift.

Given Lin Yuan's current strength, even a casual display of these two powers was terrifying to the extreme, thoroughly severing the pervasive suction in the surrounding space-time.

Zzzzz!!!

The chains formed by Taiyi and Taichu Power imprisoned the terrifying rift, instantly beginning to refine and seal it.

An intangible aura permeated the confinement of the chains, causing the terrifying rift to continuously collapse upon contact with the combined power of these two forces.

"Such a method, at most, will only allow me to-" The will from the depth initially felt there was nothing noteworthy.

But in just half a moment.

The intangible aura extinguished half of the terrifying rift.

"What kind of method is this?"

"No, you can't seal me. I can offer you benefits..."

The last word remained unfinished, as no further sound or will

emanated.

For the entire terrifying rift had been completely isolated and sealed, the intangible aura even penetrated the deepest parts of the rift,

heavily wounding that will.

"Benefits, what benefits could you offer me?"

Lin Yuan was unfazed, through enduring the 3.6 billion and two thousand calamities, he had gained an understanding of entities similar to the will within rift depths.

They were nothing more than 'parasitic worms' in the infinite dimensions, remnants of a malfunctioning Dao operation.

Could the benefits they offer surpass the feedback from the infinite

dimensions?

Furthermore, bypassing the will in the rift depths would mean Lin Yuan's failure, provoking the Supreme Rule Dao to personally

obliterate him.

Lin Yuan naturally knew the choice he had to make. From afar, in the numerous dimensional spaces, strong entities sensed their home dimensions moving toward the terrifying rift but found themselves helpless. Without the power of a stage thirteen Time Lifeform, they couldn't survive long after leaving their dimensions.

Originally, these strong beings could only wait desperately as their home dimensions edged closer to being entirely consumed by the rift. But as Lin Yuan took action, they stood dumbstruck as the rift they

had deemed hopeless was rapidly vanishing.

"Which great being has saved us..."

The beings within each dimensional space worshipped fervently, never witnessing who intervened, yet they revered and admired the

unseen savior.

"It's over."

Within just half a breath, the terrifying rift completely vanished.

The sweeping refining power of Taiyi and Taichu did not allow the terrifying rift any resistance.

Other Time Lords, even if they could seal the terrifying rift, would have to spend countless ages, enduring possibly tens or hundreds of great destructive cycles, inching their way to seal the will in the rift

depths.

But for Lin Yuan, resolving everything in less than half a breath, it was

an absolute display of overwhelming power.

In the following moment.

Boom-

The feedback from the infinite dimensions poured into Lin Yuan's

body.

As the final calamity of the first stage, its difficulty far surpassed the previous billions of calamities, naturally leading to a greater feedback

intensity.

It took Lin Yuan dozens of breaths to conclude the feedback state.

"Not bad."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Although the power gain was modest, there was still more to follow.

The second stage's calamities should provide feedback no less

significant than this one after each trial.

"Time to head back."

Lin Yuan didn't bother checking anything further; he turned and left.

With even the Supreme Rule Dao confirming Lin Yuan's passage

through the trial, there was no need to verify anything.

"Hmm?"

"Many new causes and effects?"

Suddenly, Lin Yuan felt stirred, looking toward the distant dimensional spaces. With a thought, he immediately identified the source of these causes and effects.

By sealing and resolving the terrifying rift, he had spared these dimensional spaces from destruction, leading countless beings within to worship and, as a result, naturally forming a web of causal ties.

Of course, these causal connections were one-sided; only Lin Yuan could perceive them, while the other beings were unaware of Lin

Yuan's existence.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

"With the first stage's trials concluded, it's time to begin the second

stage."

Lin Yuan enhanced his spiritual will, contacting the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, soon receiving the specifics of his second stage

trial.

"Quite simple."

Lin Yuan glanced over it, finding it manageable and promptly sent the

Taiji Primordial Spirit to fulfill it.

The power of the Taiji Primordial Spirit was now in no way inferior to

Lin Yuan's true self, though when divided into Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit, it was slightly weaker.

In the boundless vastness of the infinite dimensions. Suddenly, ripples of strange energy surfaced in a distant time-space.

This energy emerged from nowhere, supreme yet immediate, rapidly

spreading and penetrating the infinite dimensions.

"What's happening?"

"What is this power?"

"It can actually affect the infinite dimensions?" Time Lords expressed disbelief, and some ancient Legendary Lords were forcefully awakened, incredulously sensing the peculiar power waves permeating nearly the entire dimensional reality.
